title: The Emergency
subtitle: A Newspaper With a Blank Column

sources.title: Forty-second Amendment of the Constitution of India

context.title: 1917 — The record
context.text: Indira Priyadarshini Gandhi (née Nehru; 19 November 1917 - 31 October 1984) was an Indian stateswoman who twice served as the Prime Minister of India from 1966 to 1977 and again from 1980 until her assassination in 1984.

context.title: 1930 — The record
context.text: In 1930, the Nehru family donated the mansion to the Indian National Congress and renamed it Swaraj Bhavan (meaning abode of freedom).

context.title: 1934 — The record
context.text: Indira Nehru was taught mostly at home by tutors and attended school intermittently until matriculation in 1934.

context.title: 1937 — The record
context.text: After her mother died, Indira attended the Badminton School in Bristol, England for a short time period and then enrolled at Somerville College in Oxford in 1937 to study history.

context.title: 1940 — The record
context.text: She was there in 1940, when Germany rapidly conquered Europe.

context.title: 1941 — The record
context.text: She managed to enter England in early 1941, and from there returned to India without completing her studies at Oxford.

debates.question: Was the order necessary?
debates.hook: The government called it stability; the record shows what it cost.
debates.stakes: If the order was necessary, the cost is a price; if it was not, the cost is the charge.
debates.uncomfortable: Both sides can cite the same night; the difference is who they believe was counted.
debates.whatWouldChange: A contemporaneous security assessment that named a specific threat, not a general one.

debates.question: Did the machine stay inside the law?
debates.hook: A proclamation is a sentence; the arrests, censors and tribunals are the grammar.
debates.stakes: A legal emergency and a legal cover are hard to tell apart from inside the machinery.
debates.uncomfortable: The courts that could have checked the order were part of the order's design.
debates.whatWouldChange: A court ruling that struck the order down while it was still in force.

debates.question: What did the record settle?
debates.hook: An inquiry writes the first draft of the argument, not its last word.
debates.stakes: If the record is complete, the debate is about judgment; if it is not, it is about the record.
debates.uncomfortable: The commission had the power to recommend, not the power to punish.
